headline: Ye responded to a video of himself making the crowd sing “Heartless” louder and louder Aft
body: Ye responded to a video of himself making the crowd sing “Heartless” louder and louder After repeatedly getting fans to run it back, he explained in his response: “The crowd was very loud” and “It’s called rock and roll. ” While responding to a tweet Released in 2008 as the second single from “808s & Heartbreak,” “Heartless” peaked at No. 2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 30 weeks on the chart. The song reached 14× Platinum in the U. S.

source_caption_text:
Ye responded to a video of himself making the crowd sing “Heartless” louder and louder 🐐🔥

After repeatedly getting fans to run it back, he explained in his response: “The crowd was very loud” and “It’s called rock and roll.” While responding to a @yzyupdates tweet 

Released in 2008 as the second single from “808s & Heartbreak,” “Heartless” peaked at No. 2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 30 weeks on the chart.

The song reached 14× Platinum in the U.S. in July 2026, representing 14 million certified units from sales and streaming equivalents. Nearly 18 years after its release, it’s still bringing stadium crowds together to sing every word.

Is “Heartless” a top 10 Ye song? 👀
